lines.beaver: 오늘은 밤을 넣은 김밥을 만들어 보자.
lines.beaver_en: Today let's make gimbap with chestnuts.
lines.beaver_roman: oneureun bameul neoeun gimbabeul mandeureo boja.
lines.en: Okay. What do I have to do first?

lines.beaver: 먼저 밥을 해야지. 밤은 깨끗이 씻었니?
lines.beaver_en: First we cook rice. Did you wash the chestnuts?
lines.beaver_roman: meonjeo babeul haeyaji. bameun kkaekkeusi ssisseonni?
lines.learner: 네, 씻어 놨어요. 이제 밤을 넣어야 돼요?
lines.en: Yes, I washed them. Do I have to add them now?
lines.roman: ne, ssiseo nwasseoyo. ije bameul neoeoya dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 응, 이제 밤을 넣을 차례야. 쌀 위에 올려.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, now it's time for the chestnuts. Put them on the rice.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, ije bameul neoeul charyeya. ssal wie ollyeo.
lines.learner: 다 올렸어요. 물은 얼마나 넣어야 돼요?
lines.en: Done. How much water do I have to add?
lines.roman: da ollyeosseoyo. mureun eolmana neoeoya dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 평소처럼 넣으면 돼. 밥이 되면 간을 하자.
lines.beaver_en: As usual. When the rice is done, let's season it.
lines.beaver_roman: pyeongsocheoreom neoeumyeon dwae. babi doemyeon ganeul haja.
lines.en: I have to mix sugar and salt into vinegar, right?

lines.beaver_en: Right. Mix it well and stir it into the rice.
lines.learner: 좀 싱거워요. 소금을 더 쳐야 돼요?
lines.en: It's a bit bland. Do I have to sprinkle more salt?
lines.roman: jom singgeowoyo. sogeumeul deo chyeoya dwaeyo?

lines.beaver: 조금만 더 쳐. 이제 김 위에 밥을 펴.
lines.beaver_en: Just a little more. Now spread rice on the seaweed.
lines.beaver_roman: jogeumman deo chyeo. ije gim wie babeul pyeo.
lines.en: Do I have to spread the rice thin?

lines.beaver: 응, 얇게. 그리고 재료를 올리고 꼭 말아.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, thin. Then add the fillings and roll it tight.
lines.beaver_roman: eung, yalkke. geurigo jaeryoreul olligo kkok mara.
lines.learner: 이렇게 꼭 말아야 돼요? 좀 어려워요.
lines.en: Do I have to roll it tight like this? It's hard.
lines.roman: ireoke kkok maraya dwaeyo? jom eoryeowoyo.

lines.beaver: 잘하네. 다음에 혼자 하면 뭘 조심해야 돼?
lines.beaver_en: You're good. Next time alone, what must you be careful of?
lines.beaver_roman: jalhane. daeume honja hamyeon mwol josimhaeya dwae?
lines.en: I have to sprinkle salt little by little.

lines.beaver: 그렇지. 썰 때는 칼에 물을 묻혀.
lines.beaver_en: That's right. When slicing, wet the knife.
lines.beaver_roman: geureochi. sseol ttaeneun kare mureul muchyeo.
lines.en: Okay, I'll wet the knife and slice it.

lines.beaver_en: Well done. Now let's eat together.
lines.learner: 네! 제 첫 김밥 요리, 정말 맛있겠네요.
lines.en: Yes! My first gimbap looks really tasty.
lines.roman: ne! je cheot gimbap yori, jeongmal masitgenneyo.
